summary: Built and maintained a Telegram integration node for n8n, shipped a cross-platform file-tagging utility to the Microsoft Store, and bootstrapped an Android chat app with an ASP.NET Core backend featuring tool-call safety rails.

items.title: Bootstrapped Ozwil Android app and backend
items.description: Initialized a new Android app with an ASP.NET Core backend, adding tool-call safety rails, a MarkdownText composable, and chat UI cleanup.

items.title: Stabilized n8n TelePilot node CI/CD
items.description: Resolved npm registry errors and auth race conditions in CI, upgraded test infrastructure to n8n 2.8.3, and added a new album trigger.

items.title: Released Intag v2.0 on Microsoft Store
items.description: Shipped version 2.0 of the Windows file-tagging utility with support for additional metadata properties and a Microsoft Store listing.

items.title: Fixed TDLib session persistence in n8n node
items.description: Moved TDLib session storage to a stable path outside node_modules to prevent data loss across updates.

items.title: Added Docker deployment support for n8n TelePilot node
items.description: Created Debian-based and Alpine Linux Docker configurations for deploying n8n with the TelePilot2 node.
